name: Indigo Denim Jacket
description: A classic trucker silhouette in deep indigo wash. Sturdy 12oz denim that softens with wear, antique brass hardware, and a slightly cropped cut that layers well over knits.

name: White Linen Shirt
description: Breezy European flax linen with a relaxed collar and mother-of-pearl buttons. Cut loose through the body for warm days; tucks clean for evening.

name: Floral Midi Dress
description: A flowing midi in vintage-inspired floral crepe. Square neckline, shirred back panel, and a skirt that moves. From garden party to gallery opening.

name: Black Slim Jeans
description: Our signature slim fit in saturated black stretch denim that keeps its color. Mid-rise, tapered leg, no-fade guarantee for the first fifty washes.

name: Camel Wool Coat
description: A single-breasted overcoat in Italian wool-cashmere blend. Clean lines, horn buttons, fully lined. The coat that finishes every winter outfit.

name: Striped Knit Sweater
description: Breton stripes on a mid-weight cotton knit. Drop shoulders, ribbed trims, and the kind of easy shape that works over a collar or on its own.

name: Olive Utility Jacket
description: A field jacket in washed olive cotton twill. Four patch pockets, drawcord waist, and a garment-dyed finish that already looks broken in.

name: Silk Paisley Scarf
description: Hand-rolled edges on pure mulberry silk twill, printed with an archival paisley in plum and ochre. Wear it at the neck, in the hair, or on the bag.
